description: Source code for Git's tracing and performance logging functionalities, including trace initialization, timestamping, and repository setup logging.

methods.name: get_trace_fd
methods.description: Retrieves or initializes the trace file descriptor based on environment variable or override.

methods.name: trace_override_envvar
methods.description: Overrides the trace environment variable with a specified value and reinitializes trace settings.

methods.name: trace_disable
methods.description: Disables tracing for a given trace key, closing file descriptors if needed.

methods.name: prepare_trace_line
methods.description: Prepares a trace line with timestamp, file, and line info if tracing is enabled.

methods.name: trace_write
methods.description: Writes trace data to the trace file descriptor.

methods.name: trace_verbatim
methods.description: Outputs raw trace data if tracing is enabled.

methods.name: print_trace_line
methods.description: Completes and outputs a trace line.

methods.name: trace_vprintf_fl
methods.description: Formats and outputs a trace message with variable arguments.

methods.name: trace_argv_vprintf_fl
methods.description: Formats and outputs a trace message with command-line arguments.

methods.name: trace_strbuf_fl
methods.description: Outputs a trace message from a strbuf.

methods.name: trace_performance_enter
methods.description: Marks the start time of a performance measurement.

methods.name: trace_performance_vprintf_fl
methods.description: Outputs a performance trace message with timing info.

methods.name: trace_printf_key_fl
methods.description: Outputs a formatted trace message for a specific trace key.

methods.name: trace_argv_printf_fl
methods.description: Outputs a formatted trace message with command-line arguments.

methods.name: trace_performance_fl
methods.description: Outputs a performance trace message.

methods.name: trace_performance_leave_fl
methods.description: Marks the end of a performance measurement and outputs elapsed time.

methods.name: quote_crnl
methods.description: Escapes special characters in file paths for trace output.

methods.name: trace_repo_setup
methods.description: Logs repository setup details such as directories and paths.

methods.name: trace_want
methods.description: Checks if tracing is enabled for a given key.

methods.name: highres_nanos
methods.description: Returns high-resolution monotonic time in nanoseconds.

methods.name: gettimeofday_nanos
methods.description: Returns current time in nanoseconds since epoch using gettimeofday.

methods.name: getnanotime
methods.description: Returns current time in nanoseconds with high resolution, falling back if necessary.

methods.name: print_command_performance_atexit
methods.description: Outputs command performance data at program exit.

methods.name: trace_command_performance
methods.description: Starts performance tracing for a command.
